newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends flat vs dlr, seen drifting lower.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends flat vs dlr, seen drifting lower.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Romania's leu currency on Tuesday marked time at 5,450/500 to the dollar on a stalled interbank market, hit by months-long hard currency squeezes.
* Dealers said hard currency owners kept away from trading, awaiting a better rate for the dollar to sell. They said the leu might ease towards 5,800/6,000 this week.
* Trading in other currencies, such as the Austrian Schilling, offered weaker leu-dollar rates of up to 6,100 in cross deals, operators said.
* Latest central bank data showed $50,500 interbank volume on Monday, when overall trading was $10.34 million.
* Trading on an overliquid money market was blocked with short-term funds near 50 percent. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
